morning.caption:
Two extra days in Antalya, but no cover decision. COP31 closed on Sunday after the EU and others rejected a text that named no fossil fuels, taking a draft 500 Mt a year capture goal and a 35% electrification target with it.

Why it matters for capital and water: carbonenergynexus.com

midday.caption:
Data center developers and pipeline and power builders all have a stake: the US Senate passed S. 5653 on Nov 19, limiting court challenges, protecting issued permits and making data centers pay for their grid upgrades. The House decides next.

Today's edition: carbonenergynexus.com

#Permitting #DataCenters #PowerGrid #EnergyPolicy

evening.caption:
A 10% weekly drop in the Nasdaq, then a Monday turn: US futures rallied, Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, and LME copper climbed back above $12,000 after AI demand doubts dragged it to its weakest since March.
